verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a user-definable rules engine that triggers actions automatically when events occur. Webhooks (docs-14, docs-33, docs-35) only send event notifications to a developer's endpoint, so they are a building block for constructing automation, not the capability itself. Mandates let payments execute without re-authorisation but still have to be created by the integrator. 'Configure sweeping' (docs-20) is a single mention with no description of rule or event triggers, so it is at most an adjacent feature.
